purpose: Evaluation manifest for rotation-signal integrity. Case labels describe documented scan context, not a per-gate tornado or hydrometeor truth label.
calibration_policy: Do not select a raw-shear, distance, or polarimetric threshold from this manifest alone. Record the population, source, and false-positive/missed-signal trade-off before changing a production threshold.

cases.label: null_clear_air
cases.evidence: Six consecutive local scans selected for very sparse >=20 dBZ echo and clutter/biological persistence measurement; not a severe-event truth set.

cases.label: confirmed_tornado_context
cases.evidence: SPC 2013-05-20 tornado report, 19:56 UTC, Newcastle/Moore, OK; later confirmed EF5 by NWS Norman damage survey. Volume timestamp 19:55:27 UTC.

cases.label: confirmed_hail_context
cases.evidence: SPC 2013-05-20 hail report, 20:06 UTC, 3 NNW Moore, OK, 2.50 in hail. Volume timestamp 20:03:56 UTC.
